title: Women's health - NHS
content: Women's health Information and support on health, wellbeing, conditions and screening Periods Including painful periods, heavy periods, PMS and adenomyosis Contraception Different methods of contraception and how effective they are Pregnancy Getting pregnant, keeping well in pregnancy, giving birth and more Menopause Symptoms of menopause and perimenopause Vagina and vulva health Including infections and conditions that can affect your vagina and the area around it (your vulva) Womb and ovary health Including ovarian cysts, polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) and womb (uterus) cancer Abortion What's involved in an abortion, and how to get one ADHD Women and girls with ADHD (attention deficit hyperactivity disorder) are more likely to go undiagnosed Anaemia Signs of anaemia, how to prevent it and where to get help Autism Women and girls can show different symptoms of neurodiverse conditions like autism Bladder and urinary health Including urinary tract infections (UTIs), kidney infections and leaking pee Bone, joint and muscle health Including arthritis, osteoporosis and fibromyalgia Breast health Including breast pain, breast lumps and breast screening Cancer Cancers that can affect women, and cancer screening for women Dementia Some types of dementia, such as Alzheimer's, affect more women than men Domestic violence, abuse or rape What to do if you experience domestic violence, abuse or rape Heart health Including heart attack and palpitations HRT (hormone replacement therapy) Find out about different types of HRT to treat symptoms of menopause and perimenopause Infertility Information on fertility problems and potential treatments Mental health Get information and support for mental health, including depression and anxiety Pelvic health Conditions that can affect your pelvic area and how to do pelvic floor exercises Sexual health Including sexually transmitted infections (STIs) and visiting a sexual health clinic
